summary: BI-EB4BB4A0 (owner direction 2026-11-20, WWMD DI-1F6CA0FA20D8). Migration 20261120180000_workroom_dispatch_build_effect adds the 'dispatch-build' value to WorkroomEffectKind. Build Studio's approved-plan dispatch, which used to be a fire-and-forget call after the plan→build write, is now owed as a WorkroomEffect committed in the same transaction as that write and run once by the Workroom effect worker. No new table or column.
affectedCopies: WorkroomEffect rows of kind dispatch-build: inserted by apps/web/lib/build/build-dispatch-effect.ts inside the plan→build transaction (plan-to-build-transition-core.ts owedWithWrite) and by the admin dispatch test route; one per build (commandKey build-dispatch:<buildId>); run by the effect worker through the executor registered in build-dispatch-effect.server.ts; cascade with their Workroom.

privacyAssessment.sensitivity: internal: the build id and the dispatching user's id (an internal account reference already held on the build and the room).
privacyAssessment.dataSubjectRights: No content about a person; the user id is a reference already present on FeatureBuild and the Workroom.
privacyAssessment.reviewDisposition: Covered by the WorkroomEffect model's telemetry-bounded lifecycle (180 days on createdAt).

migration.name: 20261120180000_workroom_dispatch_build_effect
migration.backfill: None. Builds already in build keep the runs they have; the existing build-phase reconcilers still cover them.
migration.rollback: Forward-only and additive; an enum value cannot be dropped without recreating the type, and nothing requires dropping it. Reverting the code leaves unused rows that settle or age out.

changes.lifecycleDisposition: Telemetry-bounded: settled rows are history of the room's runtime (180 days on createdAt); unsettled rows are live work. Cascades with its Workroom.

fields.reason: Enum gains dispatch-build, an approved Build Studio plan's build dispatch.
